name: section-team
title: Team Section
description: Team section in three layouts (grid, rows, minimal) that takes its colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Grid
layouts.description: One member per cell with a round portrait, name, role, bio and links, in one, two or three columns as the width grows; the default.

layouts.title: Rows
layouts.description: One member per row in a card, a large portrait beside the text from md, the portrait side alternating; without any portrait it draws the grid.
layouts.usage: <TeamSection layout="rows" content={{ title, members: [{ name, role, bio, image }] }} />

layouts.title: Minimal
layouts.description: Names, roles and links in a compact list, no portraits and no bios.
layouts.usage: <TeamSection layout="minimal" content={{ title, members: [{ name, role, links }] }} />

proof: installs alone on Next 16; three layouts (grid, rows, minimal); grid equals page-about 2.0.0's team grid; 3 sample brands, light and dark, at 390/768/1280 px in two host apps; axe clean; no leak
postMessage: See components/section-team/README.md for the layouts, the design tokens it reads and the content props.
